'''Engo Whitt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who resided on [[Quesh]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He once trained a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] who had won the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]].
